results.title: Minot Parks celebrates 50 years of Steve Kottsick at Souris Valley Golf Course
results.description: Souris Valley golf pro Steve Kottsick has worked at the course for 50 years, and on Monday, Minot Parks commemorated his half-century of service to the game of golf in Minot, while also celebrating his 75th birthday.

results.title: Ken Rosenthal gets roasted for his MLB trade deadline reporting mistake
results.description: Ken Rosenthal pulled a Bob Nightengale during Monday’s MLB trade deadline. The Athletic reporter Rosenthal got roasted for a mistake that he made in reporting the trade of Foster Griffin.
